title: LITTLE DARLIN'
lyrics_plain:
Uh little darlin', Oh lil' darlin',
Oh ho ho ho, where are you?
My uh lover, I was wrong uh,
to try uh, to love you.
Ah ooh ah ooh ah ooh ah ooh
Know well uh, that my love uh,
was just for you.
Ah ooh ah ooh ah ooh ahooooh...
(Spoken)
My darling I need you to call my own
and never do wrong.
To hold in mine, your little hand.
I'll know too soon, that all is so grand.
Please hold my hand.

to try uh, to love you.
